name: Creately
description: Creately is a visual workspace for diagramming, whiteboarding, knowledge, and project planning. Teams use an infinite canvas, data-linked diagrams, custom databases, tasks, comments, and shared documents to move from ideas to execution.
agentUseSummary: Creately cannot be connected to agents through Relay's public Marketplace because Creately publishes no open account API or delegated OAuth contract; its API and embedding work require an Enterprise or partner engagement.

blocked.label: Connect a Creately account
blocked.description: Creately does not publish a supported OAuth or account connection contract for public third-party applications.

blocked.label: Use Creately account data
blocked.description: Creately does not publish the authentication method, endpoints, schemas, scopes, or rate limits needed to read or change a customer's workspaces through a public API.

blocked.label: Run Creately agent actions
blocked.description: Relay Console cannot mount an undocumented enterprise API or Creately's private application interface as agent tools.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without a distributable Creately API agreement and supported technical contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No documented public Creately account API is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No documented public Creately account API is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Creately markets API integration and embedding through Enterprise and partner engagements but publishes no open account API or delegated OAuth contract for public third-party applications.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request credentials or show Connect. Reconsider Creately if it grants Relay Console a distributable Enterprise or partner API agreement with current documentation and credentials.

evidence.supports: Creately markets its API for embedding, customization, and white-label work through Enterprise services and a sales engagement rather than a public developer program.
Creately lists advanced API integrations in its Enterprise plan context without publishing self-service credentials, OAuth scopes, endpoints, or schemas.
Creately asks companies that want to integrate Creately into their products to apply for a partner relationship.
Creately lists its supported product integrations but provides no public developer account API or delegated authorization contract.
Creately describes a visual collaboration product for diagramming, whiteboarding, project planning, tasks, databases, and shared work.
